description: The latest snow report for one resort with provenance, inside the conditions contract v2 envelope: `data.status` is the derived operating status (OPEN, CLOSED_TODAY, PRE_SEASON, OFF_SEASON or UNKNOWN; OPEN only on a fresh operator lift feed or a resort-confirmed opening date, never by default) with `reasons`; every field in `data` (base depth measured and operator-reported, new snow 24 h / 48 h, SWE, percent of normal, lifts and runs open / total, surface, snow quality, temperature, wind, blended 48-hour forecast, season dates) is `{value, source, observedAt, confidence, freshness: {tier, ageHours}}`; `depthDisagreement` is set when the station and the operator differ by more than 30 % (quote the measured value); `sentence` is a dated line to quote. The classic Resort document (`snow`, `season`, `cams`, `profile`, `measuredNow`) rides alongside for compatibility. Use it for "is X open today" as well as "what are conditions at X". Sources: `snotel` = measured at a USDA NRCS SNOTEL station near the resort (station elevation, not the summit), `open_meteo` = weather-model estimate for resorts without a station.

issuedAt.description: Newest model issue instant among the runs blended.

modelCount.description: Models contributing to the first day.

models.description: Every model id that contributed to any day.

date.description: The day with the most blended snowfall.

windowDays.description: Consecutive days around the peak with at least 1 cm (the storm window).

peak.description: Null when no day has any blended snow.

point.description: The elevation the summary is for: summit when the resort has a summit point, else base.

forecast.description: Headline numbers from the blended 14-day forecast (summit point when one exists). Null when no run is current; absent on list and compare rows. The full daily blend and every model run are at `/resorts/{slug}/forecast`.

forecastScores.description: Per-model verification at this resort over 90 days, ranked; empty until the scorer has measured days. Detail at `/resorts/{slug}/forecast-accuracy`.

biasRatio.description: Sum(forecast) / sum(observed); above 1 means the model over-forecasts snow.

day1Mae.description: Mean absolute error of the day-1 snowfall forecast, cm.

rank.description: 1 = lowest day-1 MAE among the models scored at this resort (the blend is ranked too). Null before the first scoring run.

license.description: URL of the terms that govern reuse.

state.description: US state / CA province code, or the country name for Andes resorts.

measuredNow.description: Latest observation per station, once the station layer is live.

ageMinutes.description: Minutes between `observedAt` and `generatedAt`. Daily sources read 1,440 or more; hourly sources under 120 when live.

attribution.description: The credit line the provider's terms ask for.

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance from the resort's coordinates.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation. Every value below describes this elevation.

newSnowIn.description: New snow over the provider's own period (24 h for daily sources), inches. Null for hourly sources, which do not measure it.

observedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant of the observation; a daily value is stamped at the end of its UTC day.

role.description: summit / mid / base by the station's elevation against the resort's vertical.

sourceId.description: The provider's own station id, e.g. `AMB`, `1308:UT:SNTL`, `USC00420072`.

localDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD at the resort when the status was resolved.

newestObservationAt.description: The newest `observedAt` across the populated fields.

resolvedAt.description: ISO instant the status was evaluated at (ages are measured from it).

timeZone.description: IANA zone the resort's calendar day runs on.

aliases.description: Other names the resort is known by, e.g. `A-Basin`.
